sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Wilson Shepard, Adash Stanley (PG), AJ Dybantsa (SF)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Wilson Shepard meet with the media to address his excitement fot the seaon and is eager to show Oakland what they have in the Oaks. Shepard shared that he felt the Oaks will catch people off guard this season. Shepard shared that Adash Stanley and AJ Dybantsa would be full go for opening night next cycle and confirmed his starting 5 would be ; Adash Stanley, Dillon Brooks, AJ Dybantsa, Jerami Grant, Wendell Carter.
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: The Oaks are a full go for opening night , starting 5 announced.

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Travis Coles (SP), Clark Saryan (RP), Vladimir Gonzalez (RF), Desmond Morton (LF)
sportsFeeds.Notes: Game 1 of the ALDS was a 14 inning instant classic. Travis Coles took the ball in game 1 and went 6 innings while surrendering 9 hits and 2 runs. Not his dominant norm but more than giving the team a chance to win. Clark Saryan made is MLB debut , after a suprising playoff roster add, went 2 innings in relief striking out 5 hitters. Playing hero on the offensive side , Vladimir Gonzalez with a 2-run homerun and Desmond Morton with a solo homerun and the walk off single in the bottom of the 14th to secure the game 1 win.
sportsFeeds.Stats: Travis Coles/6IP/9H/2ER/7SO, Clark Saryan/2IP/1H/5SO, Vladimir Gonzalez/2-6/1HR/2RBI, Desmond Morton/2-6/1HR/2RBI
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: A's take game 1 vs Yankees, A's 5 vs Yankees 4

sportsFeeds.Notes: After a game 2 loss that saw the A's 4 lost to the Yankees 5, the A's bounce back in game 3 to take the series lead back 2-1. Going on the road and to grab game 3 in NY is especially crucial in a best of 5 series. Playing the role hero in game 3 is the same player who filled that role in game 1, Desmond Morton. Desmond Morton would be responsible for 4 rbi and also hit his 2nd homerun of the post season. Pending free agent and A's icon Mark Aitken also hit a homerun in this game.
sportsFeeds.Stats: Henry Rivas/6IP/3H/2ER/4SO, Desmond Morton/2-4/1HR/4RBI, Mark Aitken/2-4/1HR/1RBI
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: A's take game 3 vs Yankees, A's 8 vs Yankees 4

sportsFeeds.Notes: John Ellis dazzles in game 4 pitching a complete game shut out and abruptly ending the Yankees season. In what may very well be John Ellis most dominate performance of his career he chose the most oppurtune time to but it on display. In a close out game in NY, Ellis is making sure everyone knows he is not an after thought in this stacked pitching rotation.  Eric Taveras would provide the offense punch hitting his 2nd homerun of the series. The A's will move onto the ALCS next where they will face the 2nd best team in baseball this season the Minnesota Twins. The season series was split 3-3
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: A's close out the ALDS in NY , As 4 vs Yankees 0
